facts.text: Westover Hills was named after Mary Louise Phillips, the first female board member of the Fort Worth Independent School District.
The Westover Hills Club, a historic gathering spot, has hosted swim meets, tennis matches, and casual conversations for generations.
Winding paths along the Clear Fork of the Trinity River offer residents a natural corridor for jogging, dog‑walking, and quiet reflection.
A 1938 house on a private parcel, built for Anne Burnett Hall and her husband, stands as a preserved example of early Westover Hills architecture.
The WikiXM platform lets Westover Hills residents share local news, civic updates, and community stories, keeping the town’s voice alive online.
Westover Hills is a town in Tarrant County, Texas, United States, situated within the Fort Worth metropolitan area.
